name: Temporal Coherence Heuristic for Gaussian Sorting
definition: A method that introduces a temporal coherence heuristic into the tile sorting, avoiding re-sorting of Gaussians whose depth order has not changed between frames.
summary: Temporal Coherence Heuristic for Gaussian Sorting optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by skipping redundant depth sorting for tiles where the Gaussian order remains unchanged between frames.
